UC-1145.note: A conversation whose message waits while an undo, a restore or a move holds the matter: its rail row, and the composer's working line. Replaced "Waiting for '{title}'" (rail) and "Waiting for '{title}' to finish." (U7-01, working line), which named the conversation it waited behind.

UC-1146.en: An undo, restore or move is changing this matter's papers. Your message goes once it's done.
UC-1146.note: The card over the composer while that message waits, with no buttons. Replaced U7-02 "One conversation changes a matter's papers at a time. Your message is ready to go." with Stop the other (U7-03) and Queue (U7-04): another conversation's answer no longer holds a message back (issue 15).
